_about: Public-domain John Foster (1770-1843, Baptist minister and essayist, of Bristol) for the Word Hoard: Essays in a Series of Letters (tenth edition, 1833), An Essay on the Evils of Popular Ignorance (clean from Gutenberg), Lectures at Broadmead Chapel (two series, 1845-47), The Life and Correspondence ed. J. E. Ryland (2 vols, 1848) and Critical Essays from the Eclectic Review (2 vols, 1856), raw Internet Archive OCR otherwise. Not any other John Foster: each title page ties the book to the essayist. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
